verdict.rationale: dltHub's first-party AI Harness provides agent skills and an MCP server that let a coding agent query the loaded dataset read-only and assemble marimo chart/analysis notebooks from an analysis plan. That is a thin form of AI-driven data insight. The AI itself is the user's external coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex), not a built-in insights feature, and the evidence for the analysis skill is a single index entry. Missing for 10: a native in-product AI insights or suggestions feature over user data, documentation of what insights or suggestions are generated, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Reads chart specs with ibis queries and altair code from analysis_plan.md, assembles a marimo Python file, validates, and launches.
Execute a read-only SQL query against the pipeline's destination dataset
The dltHub AI Harness is a set of skills, rules, and MCP servers that teach a general-purpose coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex) how to build production-grade pipelines
